source.title: Albanian ladder, a2-2: Udhëtim në veri (machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled Standard Albanian for the reading ladder. Drafted by an AI model; not reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model against the ladder gate (coverage and new words measured by npm run ladder:check) and the word-form checks of npm run sq:check-texts. Not reviewed by a native speaker: it may contain unnatural or incorrect Albanian. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted ladder unit; awaiting a named native reviewer (npm run review:packet). Albanian usage points in every unit: standard (Tosk) forms were chosen to be readable by the adapter; the optative ("Zoti ju bekoftë", "Zoti e ruajtë", "Qofsh i bekuar") is formulaic and is not read by the adapter. Narrative of a trip north. To check (facts): Tirana to Shkodër is about 100 km by road, about 2 to 3 hours; Shkodër is on a lake; the temperatures given are invented. The cross on the peak is a small stone cross, generic. Aorist/imperfect/pluperfect narrative with "duke" + participle.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Luani kishte rezervuar dy dhoma në Shkodër që në janar.
sentences.english: Luan had booked two rooms in Shkodër back in January.

sentences.text: Ishte dhurata e tij për ditëlindjen e Anës, që ishte në prill.
sentences.english: It was his present for Ana's birthday, which was in April.

sentences.text: Ata kishin folur për këtë udhëtim që para Pashkës, por nuk kishin pasur kohë gjatë dimrit, prandaj e kishin lënë për gusht.
sentences.english: They had talked about this trip since before Easter, but had not had time during the winter, so they had left it for August.

sentences.text: Sami ishte shumë i gëzuar kur Luani e ftoi.
sentences.english: Sam was very happy when Luan invited him.

sentences.text: Para një viti ai kishte mbërritur në Tiranë me avion dhe nuk kishte parë asgjë tjetër nga Shqipëria.
sentences.english: A year before he had arrived in Tirana by plane and had not seen anything else of Albania.

sentences.text: Nuk kishte udhëtuar në veri, dhe tani donte të shihte çdo gjë.
sentences.english: He had not travelled to the north, and now he wanted to see everything.

sentences.text: Të shtunën në mëngjes të tre u nisën me makinën e vjetër të Luanit.
sentences.english: On Saturday morning the three of them set off in Luan's old car.

sentences.text: Luani ngiste dhe Ana ishte pranë tij me hartën në dorë.
sentences.english: Luan was driving and Ana was next to him with the map in her hand.

sentences.text: Sami ishte pas tyre, me një valixhe të vogël dhe një çantë me ujë.
sentences.english: Sam was behind them, with a small suitcase and a bag with water.

sentences.text: Ana kishte marrë dy valixhe të mëdha dhe Luani qeshte me të.
sentences.english: Ana had taken two big suitcases and Luan was laughing at her.

sentences.text: — Çfarë udhëtimi do të jetë! — tha Sami duke buzëqeshur.
sentences.english: "What a trip this will be!" said Sam, smiling.

sentences.text: — Sa kilometra janë nga Tirana në Shkodër? — pyeti ai.
sentences.english: "How many kilometres is it from Tirana to Shkodër?" he asked.

sentences.text: — Janë rreth njëqind kilometra, — tha Ana.
sentences.english: "It is about a hundred kilometres," said Ana.

sentences.text: — Do të na duhen afër tri orë.
sentences.english: "We will need almost three hours."

sentences.text: Rruga kalonte nëpër një fushë të gjerë dhe pastaj përgjatë një lumi.
sentences.english: The road passed through a wide plain and then along a river.

sentences.text: Në fushë ajri ishte i nxehtë dhe bimët ishin të thata.
sentences.english: On the plain the air was hot and the plants were dry.

sentences.text: Ishte vapë e madhe, edhe pse ishte ende mëngjes.
sentences.english: It was very hot, even though it was still morning.

sentences.text: Një avion i vogël kaloi mbi fushë dhe Sami e shikoi për një sekondë.
sentences.english: A small plane flew over the plain and Sam watched it for a second.

sentences.text: — Para një viti isha në një avion si ai, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "A year ago I was on a plane like that," he said.

sentences.text: — Dhe ky vit ka qenë shumë i mirë.
sentences.english: "And this year has been very good."

sentences.text: — Në verë këtu nuk bie shi për javë me radhë, — tha Luani.
sentences.english: "In summer it does not rain here for weeks in a row," said Luan.

sentences.text: — Reshjet vijnë në dimër dhe në pranverë.
sentences.english: "The rains come in winter and in spring."

sentences.text: — Sa gradë janë tani? — pyeti Sami.
sentences.english: "How many degrees is it now?" asked Sam.

sentences.text: — Tridhjetë e dy, — tha Ana duke parë celularin.
sentences.english: "Thirty-two," said Ana, looking at the phone.

sentences.text: — Në mal do të jetë më ftohtë.
sentences.english: "In the mountains it will be colder."

sentences.text: Ata bënë një ndalesë për kafe dhe për ushqim.
sentences.english: They made a stop for coffee and for food.

sentences.text: Në fshat kishte një dasmë dhe muzika dëgjohej larg. Pronari i një kafeje të vogël u dha një gjellë tradicionale dhe pemë nga kopshti i tij.
sentences.english: In the village there was a wedding and the music could be heard from far away. The owner of a small café gave them a traditional dish and fruit from his garden.

sentences.text: — Në veri ushqimi është shumë i mirë, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "In the north the food is very good," he said.

sentences.text: — Ju duhet ta hani.
sentences.english: "You must eat it."

sentences.text: Sami e falënderoi, dhe Luani i dhuroi një libër të vogël për Tiranën.
sentences.english: Sam thanked him, and Luan gave him a small book about Tirana.

sentences.text: Ana e ngiti makinën për një orë, dhe Luani flinte duke buzëqeshur.
sentences.english: Ana drove the car for an hour, and Luan slept, smiling.

sentences.text: Pas tri orësh ata mbërritën në Shkodër.
sentences.english: After three hours they arrived in Shkodër.

sentences.text: Hoteli ishte në lagjen e vjetër, pranë një rruge të ngushtë me shtëpi të bardha.
sentences.english: The hotel was in the old neighbourhood, near a narrow street with white houses.

sentences.text: Pronari i hotelit kishte pritur disa udhëtarë, por dhomat e tyre ishin të lira.
sentences.english: The owner of the hotel had been waiting for some travellers, but their rooms were free.

sentences.text: Sami e la valixhen në dhomë dhe doli në ballkon.
sentences.english: Sam left the suitcase in the room and went out onto the balcony.

sentences.text: Poshtë tij shtrihej qyteti dhe larg ishte liqeni, me një sipërfaqe shumë të madhe.
sentences.english: Below him the town stretched out, and far away was the lake, with a very large surface.

sentences.text: Pastaj ata morën biçikleta me qira dhe ecën përgjatë liqenit.
sentences.english: Then they rented bicycles and rode along the lake.

sentences.text: Biçikleta e Samit ishte e vogël, por ai nuk ra.
sentences.english: Sam's bicycle was small, but he did not fall.

sentences.text: Luani e kishte harruar biçikletën e tij në Tiranë, prandaj mori një tjetër me qira.
sentences.english: Luan had forgotten his own bicycle in Tirana, so he rented another one.

sentences.text: Peizazhi ishte shumë i bukur: liqen i madh, male të larta dhe qiell me diell.
sentences.english: The landscape was very beautiful: a big lake, high mountains and a sunny sky.

sentences.text: — Liqeni është shumë i thellë? — pyeti Sami.
sentences.english: "Is the lake very deep?" asked Sam.

sentences.text: — Në disa vende po, — tha Luani.
sentences.english: "In some places yes," said Luan.

sentences.text: — Por pranë bregut është i vogël dhe i ngrohtë.
sentences.english: "But near the shore it is shallow and warm."

sentences.text: Peizazhi ndryshonte çdo orë dhe Sami nuk kishte parë një peizazh si ky.
sentences.english: The landscape changed every hour and Sam had never seen a landscape like this.

sentences.text: Në mbrëmje u kthyen te hoteli duke folur dhe duke qeshur.
sentences.english: In the evening they went back to the hotel, talking and laughing.

sentences.text: Kishin ngrënë peshk dhe kishin pirë çaj, dhe të gjithë ishin të lodhur.
sentences.english: They had eaten fish and had drunk tea, and everyone was tired.

sentences.text: Ditën tjetër kishin një ecje të gjatë në mal.
sentences.english: The next day they had a long walk in the mountains.

sentences.text: Luani kishte rezervuar një udhëzues që një javë më parë.
sentences.english: Luan had booked a guide a week before.

sentences.text: — Kam rezervuar edhe një taksi për orën gjashtë, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "I have also booked a taxi for six o'clock," he said.

sentences.text: Udhëzuesi i priti në hotel në orën gjashtë.
sentences.english: The guide met them at the hotel at six o'clock.

sentences.text: — Ecja është gjashtë orë, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "The walk is six hours," he said.

sentences.text: — Do të ngjiteni deri në një lartësi prej 1.800 metrash.
sentences.english: "You will climb up to a height of 1,800 metres."

sentences.text: Luani e thirri taksinë dhe shoferi i çoi deri në fund të rrugës.
sentences.english: Luan called the taxi and the driver took them to the end of the road.

sentences.text: Aty filloi udhëtimi i tyre në këmbë. Ata udhëtonin me kujdes, duke ecur përgjatë një përroi.
sentences.english: There their journey on foot began. They travelled carefully, walking along a stream.

sentences.text: Udhëzuesi ecte përpara dhe u fliste për natyrën.
sentences.english: The guide walked ahead and told them about the nature.

sentences.text: — Këtu në veri klima nuk është si klima e jugut, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Here in the north the climate is not like the climate of the south," he said.

sentences.text: — Në veri ka shumë reshje, sidomos në dimër, dhe në zonat malore ka borë.
sentences.english: "In the north there is a lot of rain, especially in winter, and in the mountain areas there is snow."

sentences.text: — Në jug ka vapë çdo verë dhe fushat janë të thata.
sentences.english: "In the south there is heat every summer and the plains are dry."

sentences.text: — Nga lindja vjen era e ftohtë dhe nga perëndimi vjen deti.
sentences.english: "From the east comes the cold wind and from the west comes the sea."

sentences.text: Ata ecën nëpër një luginë të thellë, ku kishte një përrua me ujë shumë të ftohtë.
sentences.english: They walked through a deep valley, where there was a stream with very cold water.

sentences.text: — Gjatësia e kësaj lugine është 20 kilometra, — tha udhëzuesi.
sentences.english: "The length of this valley is 20 kilometres," said the guide.

sentences.text: — Ky burim është i vjetër.
sentences.english: "This spring is old."

sentences.text: — Njerëzit e fshatit pinë prej tij prej shumë shekujsh.
sentences.english: "The people of the village have drunk from it for many centuries."

sentences.text: Sami piu nga burimi dhe buzëqeshi. Dita ishte e nxehtë, por uji ishte i ftohtë.
sentences.english: Sam drank from the spring and smiled. The day was hot, but the water was cold.

sentences.text: Ai e kishte harruar se uji mund të ishte shumë i mirë.
sentences.english: He had forgotten that water could be so good.

sentences.text: Pastaj udhëzuesi i këshilloi të bëjnë pak pushim, sepse rruga ngjitej shumë.
sentences.english: Then the guide advised them to rest a little, because the road climbed steeply.

sentences.text: — Sa lartësi kemi bërë? — pyeti Ana.
sentences.english: "How much height have we made?" asked Ana.

sentences.text: — Pothuajse 800 metra, — tha udhëzuesi.
sentences.english: "Almost 800 metres," said the guide.

sentences.text: — Dhe ajri tani është më i ftohtë.
sentences.english: "And the air is colder now."

sentences.text: Ecja ishte e vështirë, por udhëtarët nuk thoshin asgjë.
sentences.english: The walk was difficult, but the travellers said nothing.

sentences.text: Në mesditë ata nuk dinin më ku ishin.
sentences.english: At midday they no longer knew where they were.

sentences.text: Udhëzuesi kishte thënë të mbanin djathtas, por Luani kishte marrë majtas duke menduar se ishte më e shkurtër.
sentences.english: The guide had said to keep to the right, but Luan had taken the left, thinking it was shorter.

sentences.text: Ata ecën një orë duke folur dhe pa parë njeri.
sentences.english: They walked for an hour, talking and without seeing anyone.

sentences.text: Pastaj panë një përrua tjetër dhe një kufi të vjetër prej guri.
sentences.english: Then they saw another stream and an old stone boundary.

sentences.text: — Nuk jemi larg kufirit, — tha Ana duke qeshur.
sentences.english: "We are not far from the border," said Ana, laughing.

sentences.text: — Po shkojmë në një vend tjetër!
sentences.english: "We are going to another country!"

sentences.text: — Sam, thirr udhëzuesin, — tha Luani.
sentences.english: "Sam, call the guide," said Luan.

sentences.text: Sami e thirri me celular dhe udhëzuesi u përgjigj shpejt.
sentences.english: Sam called him on the mobile and the guide answered quickly.

sentences.text: — Rrini aty ku jeni, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Stay where you are," he said.

sentences.text: — Po vij.
sentences.english: "I am coming."

sentences.text: Pas njëzet minutash ai mbërriti, i shqetësuar por i qetë.
sentences.english: After twenty minutes he arrived, worried but calm.

sentences.text: — Çdo gjë është mirë, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Everything is fine," he said.

sentences.text: — Çdo udhëtar e ka kaluar një herë një ditë si kjo.
sentences.english: "Every traveller has had a day like this once."

sentences.text: Në mbrëmje ata mbërritën në një vend të lartë, ku shihej e gjithë lugina.
sentences.english: In the evening they reached a high place from which the whole valley could be seen.

sentences.text: Aty kishte një kryq të vogël prej guri. Ishte dita e tretë e udhëtimit të tyre.
sentences.english: There was a small stone cross there. It was the third day of their journey.

sentences.text: Sami heshti. Ai u përul, sepse natyra para tij ishte shumë e madhe.
sentences.english: Sam fell silent. He humbled himself, because the nature before him was so great.

sentences.text: Në atë moment ai mendoi për gjithë botën dhe për Perëndinë që e kishte bërë.
sentences.english: At that moment he thought of the whole world and of God who had made it.

sentences.text: Nuk tha asgjë. Vetëm falënderoi Perëndinë në heshtje.
sentences.english: He said nothing. He only thanked God in silence.

sentences.text: Pas pak Ana e mori për dore.
sentences.english: After a while Ana took him by the hand.

sentences.text: — Është koha të zbresim, — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "It is time to go down," she said.

sentences.text: — Taksia na pret poshtë.
sentences.english: "The taxi is waiting for us below."

sentences.text: Ditën tjetër në mëngjes Luani u kthye në Tiranë me makinën, duke ngarë me kujdes.
sentences.english: The next morning Luan drove back to Tirana, driving carefully.

sentences.text: Ana flinte, dhe Sami shikonte nga dritarja fushat, malet dhe lumenjtë që kalonin.
sentences.english: Ana slept, and Sam looked out of the window at the plains, the mountains and the rivers passing by.

sentences.text: — Në nëntor do të kthehemi, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "In November we will come back," he said.

sentences.text: — Dua ta shoh këtë vend nën borë.
sentences.english: "I want to see this place under snow."

sentences.text: — Pastaj shkojmë në jug, — qeshi Luani.
sentences.english: "Then we will go to the south," laughed Luan.

sentences.text: — Të shohim se si është Shqipëria pothuajse në çdo stinë.
sentences.english: "Let us see what Albania is like in almost every season."

sentences.text: Sami e mbylli sytë me një buzëqeshje.
sentences.english: Sam closed his eyes with a smile.

sentences.text: Ai e dinte që nuk do ta harronte atë udhëtim.
sentences.english: He knew he would not forget that trip.

sentences.text: Ata kishin udhëtuar shumë kilometra, por ai mendonte se udhëtimi më i gjatë ishte ai në zemër.
sentences.english: They had travelled many kilometres, but he thought the longest journey was the one in the heart.
